description: This file contains test cases for verifying the behavior of git commands related to symlinks and index updates, specifically testing 'git update-index --add' and 'git add' with symlink considerations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with specified setup and command execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used for negative test cases.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output for correctness verification.
